name: greenfield
description: Build the URL shortener from scratch from a well-defined requirement
requirement: Build a URL shortener service. Users can create short links for long URLs, optionally with a custom alias. Visiting a short link redirects to the original URL. Users can view click analytics for a link: total clicks, clicks in the last 24 hours and top referrers. Provide a health check endpoint.

design_signoff.comment: New schema + public API reviewed; SQLite acceptable for v1.

policy:CHG-002.comment: New tables links/clicks are expected for a greenfield service.
